people.name: Adam
people.line: The first man, created by God

people.name: Cain
people.line: Adam and Eve's firstborn son, killed his brother Abel

people.name: Eve
people.line: First woman; wife of Adam; tempted by the serpent.

translations.web: The man knew Eve his wife. She conceived, and gave birth to Cain, and said, “I have gotten a man with Yahweh’s help.”
translations.bsb: And Adam had relations with his wife Eve, and she conceived and gave birth to Cain. “With the help of the LORD I have brought forth a man,” she said.
translations.kjv: And Adam knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man from the LORD.
translations.asv: And the man knew Eve his wife; and she conceived, and bare Cain, and said, I have gotten a man with the help of Jehovah.
